title: Chapter 711
paragraphs: Chapter 711
Episode 180. Each One's Fight (1)
When Jin was taken out of the battlefield due to Diphus' dimensional shift, the allies left in the center of Licarton were rescuing the prisoners.
"Aaaargh!"
"Uh, uh..."
"Thank you, thank you…!"
Every time a member of the Vamel Alliance split one fruit, screams, cries, and words of thanks mixed and poured out.
About 50 people per fruit.

For most of the fruits that fell to the ground, only about 30% of the prisoners inside were alive. There were some fruits that contained more survivors, but there were more fruits that didn’t show any response even if the shell was split.
"I'm Alisa Batger, the captain of the Teiken Defense Team. Come out and go where you see the light!"
"I'm Gilly MacLoran from the Vamel Alliance, go towards the light. Those who can't move will have to be taken care of by you. It will be difficult, but please move calmly."
"Hello? I'm Nodeb Sarssaeng. Is there a member of our fan club here? Ah, now's not the time. Go over there, over there. We came to save you!"
"I am the Ghost Captain, do you see the blue light over there? Somehow get there. Then our mages and knights will protect you..."
Hell was right here.
The allies were running tirelessly with that thought in mind.
Hundreds of fruits had already fallen to the ground, and the trees near the castle were still shaking off the fruits.
The blue light where the prisoners were gathering was a huge record window spread out by Valeria.
She, along with Kwall, Enya, and Hedo, were assigned the task of protecting the gathered prisoners and gathering information, rather than participating in the rescue.
"Valeria, as soon as the flare went off, Jin's energy suddenly disappeared. Is there anything appearing in the record window?"
"She's concentrating right now and can't answer! Wait a moment, I'll read the record window."

Kwall answered Hedo's question on behalf of Valeria and examined the record window. As he said, Valeria was in a state where she couldn't hear anyone else's voice as she was extracting the records of the entire battlefield.

"It's here. Diphus Runcandel and through the power of Hyungshin moved... Hmm, the name of the area where Jin moved has not yet appeared. Seeing the characters faintly trying to form, it will appear in the window over time."
Hedo was slightly bothered that Jin had left the battlefield, but he was not overly worried.
Unless Hyungshin himself took action, there should be no one in Huphester capable of killing him.

'The fleets of Zipple and Kinzelo are delayed. That means they're also dealing with Hyungshin's army, in which superhuman powerhouses are mixed... It's unlikely Jin is handling all of them. Did the 4th Order lure Jin for a one-on-one fight?'
Already about a hundred prisoners had reached the vicinity of the record window, and many more prisoners were crossing the dark plain.
[Things are going too smoothly, Hedo. The forces of chaos are strangely out of sight.]
Quicantel said, cautiously lowering a fruit to the ground.
"Every time you say that, problems arise, Quicantel. Just like now…"
Hedo drew his sword as he spoke.
What he was looking at was the front gate of Licarton Castle. A woman in a black robe was coming out of there.
The prophet, Illina Runcandel.
Hedo immediately spread his sword towards her, but Illina dissipated like fog, then regained her shape and dusted off her clothes.
Hedo shrugged his shoulders as if he had expected it and took a puff of his cigarette.
[Damn, that's right. Judging by the circumstances, it seems she's the prophet.]
"An annoying one has appeared. For a warrior or a wizard, it's just a fight, but to handle that one smoothly, one usually needs a special power like Jin."
[That must be why the 4th Flagbearer lured Jin.]
The problem is not the combat power, but the unfavorable situation.
They had to fight while protecting the prisoners, and too many aspects of Illina's abilities were unknown.
[Heroes who have come to find Licarton. Are you enjoying rescuing the prisoners?]
Illina's amplified voice lightly echoed across the battlefield.
Hedo fixed his gaze on her like a nail, and the comrades' rescue was slowed because the prisoners were scared.
[Judging by the lack of response, it seems you're not enjoying it. Well, so I have prepared a gift for you!]
Clap clap!
As Illina clapped her hands, a circle suddenly appeared in the middle of the trees that held the prisoners.
It was an 'eye.' Then the tree trunks spread sideways and started pulling out arms and legs, creating a grotesque figure.
[Insane... You're saying that wasn't a tree, but some sort of monster?]

The monsters, which had just looked like trees, were now rising from their crouched position. The fruit-bearing parts looked like heads and hair, and as the roots buried in the ground like legs spread out, each monster was even bigger than Licarton Castle.

[These are tree giants that I created with the help of the universe. You've all faced the graveyard giants, right? They're similar. Only, they just have humans hanging on the fruits on their heads. A sort of accessory, shall we say?]
In other words, there were restrictions on the group destroying the tree giants. If they made a wrong move, the fruits of the tree giants would be destroyed by the group's attack.
[This complicates things. However, Hedo, that so-called prophet... she doesn't seem to have the power to remove us.]
"I was thinking the same."
Although most of their comrades were overwhelmed by a sudden sense of urgency, Hedo and Quicantel calmly read the situation.

"The feeling of her trying to buy time is strong. Making the rescue of the prisoners difficult. The small number of Chaos troops might also be for that reason. If they had a melee with a large number of troops, the prisoners would deplete too quickly, so they know we would have no reason to fight carefully."
[She wouldn't be trying to buy time for Diphus, who's already in combat with Jin, the goal must be Hyungshin's transport. Given the obvious show she's putting on, they must be feeling some crisis.]
"Tactically, it would be better to abandon all the prisoners right now and advance to disrupt her plans. But that's not Jin's style."
[You're already talking like you're part of Vamel's alliance. Quick adaptation.]

"I worry that if Jin suffers later, Sandra will cause a scene. We might also fall into a trap within a trap if we advance. It would be best to respond calmly until the temporary allies arrive. I have a rough count."
GROOOWL!
The tree giants began to advance. Each time they moved, a dark, low rumble and an unpleasant noise of twisting wood spread.
One of them punched towards the ground. It was targeting Lata, who easily dodged the attack and managed to save a few prisoners bounced by the shockwave.
However, not all companions could do as Lata did. Those with relatively less power, like the youngest division, would have to brace for fatal injuries each time they dodged the tree giant's attack.
[Well, I hope that meeting the tree giants brings you even more thrilling joy. I will take my leave now.]
The prophet returned to Licarton Castle after saying those words.
"Quicantel, bring Yulian and the Black King."
Quicantel quickly fetched them from the battlefield.
"Yulian, from now on, you're removed from ground prisoner rescue. Instead, move with the Black King and harvest the fruits attached to the tree giants."
Yulian drops the fruits attached to the tree giants with his Harumilla bow, and Valkas transports them near the record window.
Hedo planned to rescue the prisoners attached to the giant trees in that way, utilizing Yulian's shooting skills and Valkas's strength.

"Black King, there's no need to bring the fruits all the way here perfectly. If you throw them from a distance, I'll catch them all. Also, they don't need to be too precise, even if you throw them a bit off me, I can catch them by creating a wind of sword."
"Understood."
Could that be possible, Valkas momentarily questioned, but remembering Hedo's enormous strength, he nodded.
[Valkas will have a particularly hard time. He has to secure the fruits of the giant trees while also being mindful of the protection of allies.]
Excluding the outlandish superhuman Hedo, Valkas was the only 10-star among the group, so he had to take on a lot of the responsibility for protecting the allies.
"Of course, it's true, but the Black King won't be too burdened. Because,"
Whoosh-!
Suddenly, Hedo stepped forward and swung at the air. The sword path, shot out like light, followed by cutting down the falling arm of a giant tree towards the ground.
The giant tree originally aimed to punch down Mesa Milkano, but couldn't resist the counter-attack of the sword path and stumbled back.
"Because I will protect the allies by covering the entire battlefield like this, from this spot."
Hedo cannot leave his position. The moment he moves, the prisoners gathered here will be as good as dead.
Besides, if the place where the rescued prisoners are gathering disappears, there would be complications in Valeria and Kwall's analysis as well.
[Indeed, you're a monster too, Hedo. I thought you had a countermeasure in mind, but it was simply brute force.]
His comrades admired him, but Hedo felt regretful. If only he had been in charge of Diphus and Jin was here, the prophet wouldn't have been able to pull such a stunt.
'They probably calculated that and diverted Jin in the first place.'
There were a total of eight giant trees. Hedo didn't miss a single move of theirs.

"Simply relying on strength has its limits and the moment of reaching that limit may come. Let's try to save as many prisoners as possible before that and hold on until the alliance arrives. We also need one for infiltrating the Ricarton Castle. It seems that Mary Runcandel, the seventh generation, would be suitable for that."
[I'll relay that.]
"Enya, from now on, just focus on the rear. It seems I can't pay attention to the rear at all."
"Yes, don't worry, Mr. Hedo!"
As he made the giant trees falter a few more times with long-range support, his companions were able to concentrate on rescuing the prisoners again.
Hedo's sword aura continued to spread like a glowing string between Ricarton Castle and the gathering point.
